name: JacobiNeRF Label Propagation
definition: A method for propagating semantic or instance segmentation labels from a source view to novel target views by perturbing NeRF parameters along mutual information gradients and synthesizing perturbed images.
summary: JacobiNeRF Label Propagation transfers segmentation labels to novel views by perturbing network parameters along mutual information gradients, leveraging second-order radiance field geometry rather than feature similarity.
